title: Getting Started Practice 2
statement:
Module 1 (Getting Started) covers: hello world, comments, variables, data types, input and output, operators. Solve this practice problem using what you learned.

Exercise 2: write a small program that demonstrates one concept from this module (Comments).
hints: Start by declaring your variables, then add the core logic.
Test with the simplest input first, then edge cases.
solutionExplanation: A correct solution applies the module concepts in a small working program.
